desc: the layout editor on a faked 6.5 in phone held sideways (its cutout and gesture bar kept clear), as on a playtester's phone: L dragged up into the top middle (where the long help text was, over the HUD), grabbed again there and moved back; then R dragged to the very top edge and grabbed again; the toolbar goes where it covers no control and its longest text is short; a tap on the layout button (Done) closes the editor. Before: the help text and the bar owned their whole area, so L left under them could never be grabbed again ($TTYD_TOUCH_EDIT_DO; "ui_shots": touch_<frame>_ui.png)
log_must: \[touch\] toolbar: at [-0-9]+,[-0-9]+-[-0-9]+,[-0-9]+; over controls: 0; longest text: ([0-9]|[1-3][0-9]) chars
